description: This file implements the FunctionalTensorWrapper class and related functions for managing functional tensors, including metadata handling, aliasing, mutation, and view management within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: FunctionalTensorWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for tensors to support functionalization, aliasing, and mutation tracking within PyTorch.

methods.name: set_constructor_metadata
methods.description: Initializes tensor metadata and key sets for a functional tensor wrapper.

methods.name: FunctionalTensorWrapper(const Tensor& value)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a tensor into a functional tensor wrapper.

methods.name: freeze_storage
methods.description: Freezes the storage to prevent further mutations.

methods.name: commit_update
methods.description: Applies queued updates to the underlying storage.

methods.name: is_up_to_date
methods.description: Checks if the wrapper is synchronized with its alias.

methods.name: mutate_view_meta
methods.description: Adds a view meta to the tensor, tracking view operations.

methods.name: replace_
methods.description: Replaces the tensor's value with another tensor, updating metadata accordingly.

methods.name: has_data_mutation
methods.description: Checks if the tensor's data has been mutated.

methods.name: set__impl
methods.description: Copies tensor properties from another functional tensor wrapper.

methods.name: storage_resize_
methods.description: Resizes the storage, with restrictions to prevent invalid operations.

methods.name: maybe_replace_storage
methods.description: Replaces storage if necessary, mainly for resize operations.

methods.name: _unsafe_reset_storage
methods.description: Resets the storage to match the current tensor value.

methods.name: sync_
methods.description: Synchronizes the wrapper with its alias if out of date.

methods.name: view_metas
methods.description: Returns the list of view metadata associated with the tensor.

methods.name: regenerate_from_base
methods.description: Recreates the tensor from its base and view metadata.

methods.name: apply_updates
methods.description: Applies all queued updates to the storage.

methods.name: tensorimpl_type_name
methods.description: Returns the type name of the tensor implementation.

methods.name: copy_tensor_metadata
methods.description: Copies metadata from one tensor to another.

methods.name: copy_tensor_metadata_and_refresh
methods.description: Copies metadata and refreshes size and contiguity info.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach_core
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the tensor, detaching it from autograd.

methods.name: shallow_copy_and_detach
methods.description: Creates a shallow detached copy of the tensor.

methods.name: shallow_copy_from
methods.description: Copies metadata from another tensor implementation.

methods.name: device_custom
methods.description: Returns the device of the tensor.

methods.name: sizes_custom
methods.description: Returns the sizes of the tensor.

methods.name: strides_custom
methods.description: Returns the strides of the tensor.

methods.name: dim_custom
methods.description: Returns the number of dimensions.

methods.name: numel_custom
methods.description: Returns the number of elements.

methods.name: sym_is_contiguous_custom
methods.description: Returns symbolic contiguity status.

methods.name: sym_sizes_custom
methods.description: Returns symbolic sizes.

methods.name: sym_strides_custom
methods.description: Returns symbolic strides.

methods.name: sym_size_custom
methods.description: Returns symbolic size for a dimension.

methods.name: sym_storage_offset_custom
methods.description: Returns symbolic storage offset.

methods.name: layout_impl
methods.description: Returns the tensor layout.
